traditional: Love, money, and pleasure fused with limitation, delay, and hard structure. The two act as one and the combined significations are hard to separate. The benefic Venus tempers the malefic Saturn.
modern: Affection and value meet limit. Loyalty, restraint in pleasure and love, and a strong sense of obligation. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of connection and limit is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity fused with fear and rigidity, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.summary: A relationship or financial agreement can become official at the same moment its obligations become concrete.
readerCopy.body: A relationship or financial agreement can become official at the same moment its obligations become concrete. Venus conjunct Saturn can turn affection, money, and responsibility into dates, duties, recurring costs, and consequences that are harder to treat casually once the contract is signed. That can create stability. It can also reveal how much each person expected the other to carry without saying so. Read the obligation as closely as the promise. Put the money, time, and ongoing work into the agreement before commitment becomes the reason nobody feels allowed to renegotiate it.
